newsitem.title: USA: Shared Technologies sees EBITDA up in '97.
newsitem.headline: Shared Technologies sees EBITDA up in '97.

text.p: Shared Technologies Fairchild Inc said Thursday it expected 1997 full-year revenues of about $210 million and earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) to be near $50 million in full-year 1997.
The company on Thursday reported 1996 revenues of $157 million and EBITDA of $34.9 million.
Shared Technologies reported a 1996 full-year net loss of $0.79 per common share versus a profit of $0.06 in 1996.

"We're looking forward to the 1997 fiscal year, in which we're estimating that EBITDA will come very close to $50 million on revenues of about $210 million," said Shared Technologies' chairman and chief executive Anthony D. Autorino.
"These results continue to demonstrate that the merger between Shared Technologies and Fairchild was a sound business decision."
